受 r-000004（D 提交，主题 'enveloping algebra noetherian nilpotent Lie algebra'）指派，本轮做了一次如实复核 + 补检。**先报一个质量事故**：这一行在我接手前已被标 `done=true, outcome=ok`，`result_lit_ids=000005–000022`（18 行）。我逐行读题名/DOI 核验，绝大多数与本问句无关：

- `lit:000005` Bounds for the dimension of the Schur multiplier of finite dimensional nilpotent Lie algebras (J. Algebra 2024)
- `lit:000006` The Nash–Moser theorem of Hamilton and rigidity of finite dimensional nilpotent Lie algebras (JPAA 2017)
- `lit:000007` 一条 CPEC / 推特政治人格的社科条目（DOI 10.47205/jdss.2021(2-iv)74）
- `lit:000012` Premet, Special Transverse Slices and Their Enveloping Algebras (Adv. Math. 2002) —— 讲 finite W-代数/横截片，不是本问句

## 可用的一手文献行（r-000004 的答案集）

| lit | 题名/年/DOI | 对本问句的作用 |
|---|---|---|
| 000000 | Sierra–Walton, *The universal enveloping algebra of the Witt algebra is not noetherian*, Adv. Math. 262 (2014), 10.1016/j.aim.2014.05.007 | 反面奠基：无限维 W 而 U(W) 非 Noetherian；终局问题（Conjecture 0.1 / Question 0.3）的原始出处。**全文在盘** |
| 000001 | Buzaglo, *Enveloping Algebras of Krichever–Novikov Algebras are not Noetherian*, ARTh 2022, 10.1007/s10468-022-10168-9 | 全类非 Noetherian；关键附带结果：有限余维子代数 h ⊂ g 时 U(h) Noetherian ⇔ U(g) Noetherian |
| 000002 | Andruskiewitsch–Mathieu, *Noetherian enveloping algebras of simple graded Lie algebras*, JMSJ 2025, 10.2969/jmsj/93619361 | **唯一已知的「反向蕴含」定理**：simple 且 Z^n-graded 时 U(g) Noetherian ⇒ dim g < ∞。范围是这一类，不是无条件 |
| 000023 | Bell–Buzaglo, *Enveloping Algebras of Derivations of Commutative and Noncommutative Algebras*, IMRN 2025, 10.1093/imrn/rnaf265 | 新补：有限生成代数的导子 Lie 代数，U 非 Noetherian，**不设增长限制**；经引文图由 lit:000002 前推得到 |
| 000024 | Kobayashi–Sanami, *Growth of Two-Step Solvable Lie Algebras*, PAMS 109(4) 1990, 10.1090/s0002-9939-1990-1015681-5 | 新补，r-000004 第 (1) 档（受限类）唯一命中：有限生成无限维二步可解 ⇒ 多项式增长 ⇒ U(g) 非 Noetherian 且为 Krull 整环 |
